name: actions/loading-state-button
title: Loading-state button
description: Shows progress and the outcome without changing size.

files.content:
export { LoadingStateButton } from './LoadingStateButton';
export type { LoadingStateButtonProps, LoadState } from './LoadingStateButton';

keyboard.action: Start the action, or retry after a failure. Ignored while busy.
Move focus to and from the button. Focus stays on it while busy.

notes: While busy the button sets `aria-busy` and `aria-disabled` rather than `disabled`, so it keeps focus and keyboard users are not dropped to the top of the page.
Each new state’s label is announced through a live region: politely for progress and success, assertively for failure.
Only the current label is exposed; the others are hidden from assistive technology.
Success and failure are shown with an icon and a coloured edge as well as the label, so colour is never the only signal.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The spinner does not turn, and labels change without sliding. The label still says the work is in progress.
